659fa872b631: A harness where the agent loses neither knowledge nor context
dbf5ea97ac98: Claude Code on the researcher's machine, Hermes on the server and Jev as a fast judge. Between them: hooks that fire on their own, memory that outlives sessions, and one file tree that is both the Obsidian vault and the lab base in GitLab.
d4e010367692: installed with one command together with agents, rules and hooks
b616964bdb65: fire on their own at every step of a turn, so the agent doesn't have to remember the rules
39b448f6357c: each with a name and a “checked by” line
19051d714687: memory for weeks, not for one conversation
154a22fb995c: a substantive turn with a proof and a record: 6.6 cents
6390e4bcbaf3: One agent turn: where the hooks fire
3c7dae86a433: A hook is code that Claude Code runs by itself on a turn event. The agent doesn't need to remember the rule: it stands in the way.
51dcb88b92f5: One line: where the agent is, the time, the git state.
8dcacae38c61: Names which base repository to write to from here and how to submit: straight to main or via a proposal.
0d9aac9b1f88: Matches the request against the skill catalog and slips in the right one before the agent starts acting.
428aa017792c: Blocks writing a key, token or password to a file.
14868fbf5a1a: A citation to a paper missing from the work's bibliography cannot be written: a made-up reference never reaches the text.
5a192b51cec0: Rejects writes to the old vault's paths: after the move, everything is written only into the tree.
2571945d9470: What to save from the turn
f1baae07380d: Jev assesses the turn: is there anything in it worth saving. If so, the agent gets one line — what to record and where, to memory or to the lab base, with a score.
913aa730709d: If training was launched without recording its parameters, or a proposal's checks found an error, the agent learns about it immediately, as a fact.
aa1b5fc53578: A short summary of what was done in the turn.
e2c11fdccb68: A short summary of the whole session for the record.
6dcdc9546b9f: The full session transcript is saved, and you can come back to it.
a85f6188cfe3: When the context runs out, standard compaction asks the model to summarize old turns. A summary loses exactly what you come back for later: a file path, the exact error, a command. Our fast‑jev‑compaction plugin rewrites nothing.
4ed0f15a721b: Jev is shown the whole conversation and asked two things about every tool call: is the call itself still needed, and is its result needed verbatim.
2da74990e9e5: What is needed stays as it was, an unneeded result is trimmed to its first 300 characters, and a redundant call goes away together with its result.
f990966d41eb: The owner's and the agent's text is never touched: it stays verbatim and in order.
d1cf148447ce: The first message and the last six are pinned. Questions to Jev go out as parallel requests.
949c40ff98c4: The model writes a summary. Details are lost silently.
47fb0a1a835c: Only calls that are no longer needed are removed. Everything that remains is verbatim.
66651a1d777b: Three layers, each with its own job
179ec417f73e: An agent that starts every session from scratch repeats mistakes already closed. So memory is split into layers, and the search order is fixed by a rule.
eca57d6063da: A compressed diary of turns, verbatim drawers with the owner's words, decisions and numbers, and a graph of links between entities. 37,615 records, with wings per project.
3f7859bc48ae: Claims, runs, literature, the handbook, the decision journal. Written only through a proposal: code checks it and a person accepts it.
273b81ea9510: A small local cache for quick hints. Long-term memory is the first two layers.
2eedf40fa427: When the owner asks about the past, the agent searches MemPalace first, then the tree, and only then the cache.
2f02fc946f99: The end-of-turn hook reminds the agent by itself what is worth saving from a turn, so memory grows as the work goes, not at the end of the day.
0a28b1121e30: The vault and the lab base are one tree
961fa9fad9ed: ~/brainlab mirrors the lab's GitLab: direction, topic, work, topic literature, handbook, journal, servers. Obsidian opens this same tree.
a824769e5e18: Personal and shared are visible in one window. Notes, the diary and run logs (notes/, daily/, runs/) are excluded from git and stay on the machine. Claims, the manuscript, code and literature go to GitLab.
e76c26864eb8: There is no separate “where does the project live” table: the path tells you.
7ca0cbb12371: Syncthing keeps the personal folders paired with the server, so Hermes sees the same notes as the owner.
3df58f1ade87: The style rules (icons, colors, task boards) live in the vault itself, and the agent checks against them on its own.
0b8523b3452a: Each does what it does best
178aabb7c606: The agents split work along the line of “state and execution” versus “judgment and text”. What gets handed over is not “think about this” but a task with a completion criterion.
5bdb530de08d: Judgment and text: what is worth testing, what a result means, paper prose, reviews. 77 skills and 15 specialized agents.
4cc3d5217ecf: State and execution: runs and watches experiments right next to the GPUs, keeps the task board. 12 profiles, each with a persistent session in its own Telegram topic: memory for weeks, not for a session. Wakes up by himself when a run finishes. A turn costs about two cents.
45fbbf4e8cc4: Answers yes-or-no questions with probabilities, in one fast request. Selects papers for our works, decides what to save from a turn and what to drop during context compaction.
f53dd9db8598: What the agent will not be allowed to do
fcd867f00d2b: A rule that rests on the model's memory will be broken one day. So the important ones are checked by code.
872855e7f243: A made-up citation in a paper — blocked by citation-validator.
338e2e9bcf92: A key or password in a file — blocked by security-guard.
6d22d5695eee: Writing to old paths — blocked by no-old-paths.
2e630affe44f: A number in the base that is not in the runs — the proposal's checks will not let it through.
cecb56a3df16: A push to public GitHub with personal data — publish_check exits with an error and lets nothing through.
099228d34229: Training without recording its parameters — the agent learns about it immediately, while the run can still be adopted.
c278aafd0a72: The whole set installs with one command
57d1c5abfd45: Skills, agents, commands, hooks, scripts and rules live in one claude-brainlab repository. The installer lays them out in ~/.claude, and a drift check shows how the installed copy differs from the repository.
21e18e39408a: A new member gets the same setup as the owner, not a description of it.
5347b8718c5e: A skill edit is made in the repository and shipped to everyone, instead of living on one machine.
eacb2a73ea09: lab sync assembles the lab tree for a person: their works, their literature, the handbook, the journal and the servers.
